3.4.Vitri viec lam ma sinhvien cothedamnhiem sau khi tot nghiep
Sinh vien tot nghiep tu chuong trinh cunhan noi that c6 the lam vieco ca khoi
nha nuoc,khoi tu nhan va khoi phi chinh phu, cu the tai mot so co quan, don vi, to churc
cua Nha nuoc va tu nhan hoat dong trong linh vyc Kien truc - noi that, Thiet ke va phat
trien san pham.
Vi tri viec lam ma sinh vien co the dam nhiem sau khi tot nghiep gom:
-Nhan vien thiet ke:Lam viecbo phan thiet ke cua to chuc,doanh nghiep theo
tung huong chuyen mon nhu thiet ke noi that, thiet ke be mat vat lieu, thiet ke do dac va
trang thiet bi noi that...
- Chuyen vien sang tao: La nhan vien cua bo phan sang tao, chiu trach nhiem xay
dung y tuong sang tao cho san pham, thuong hieu, chien dich truyen thong...
-Giam sat va Quan ly thiet ke: Chiu trach nhiem quan ly va xay dung ke hoach,
nhiem vu cua don vi minh quan ly,phan cong cong viecva chu tri kiem soat, quan ly
thiet ke do tu van ben ngoai thyc hien, tryc tiep lam viec voi cac cong ty tu van thiet ké
trong va ngoai nuoc, chu tri quan ly thiet ke, trien khai dy an theo phan cong, quan ly va
giao nhiem vu cho nhan vien thuoc don vi phu trach.
- Giam doc Sang tao: Chiu trach nhiem xay dyng hinh anh thuong hieu cua doanh
nghiep, thyc hien cac cong viec lien quan den hinh anh, thong diep cua cac nhan hang
hay cong ty thong qua cac kenh truyen thong. Day la churc vu quan trong tai cac cong ty
hoat dong trong linh vuc thiet ke, truyen thong, quang cao... La nguoi lanh dao xay dung
cac y tuong thiet ke,sang tao cac chien dich truyen thong,huong dan cap duoi thyc hien
cac cong viec theo ke hoach.
-Giam doc Thiet ke: To churc quan ly, dieu hanh va kiem soat toan bo cac hoat
dong cua don vi thiet ke;quan ly thiet ke theo trinh tu thuc hien dy an va theo pham vi
cong viec chuyen mon; quan ly thu tuc phap ly dy an lien quan den quy hoach, thit ké
quy hoach, thiet ke co so, ho so phe duyet du an dau tur; quan ly nha thau cung cap cac
dich vu va chi phi lien quan den thiet ke; quan ly viec lap hoac kiem tra khai toan, du
toan ve khoi lurong phuc vu cho cong tac xac dinh chi phi cung cap dich vu lien quan den
thiet ke va gia cong san pham.
